note: Grenada, read on 2026-10-30 in two Government of Grenada documents: the High Commission for Grenada in London's Instruction Sheet for Permanent Residence, and S.R.O. 26 of 2015, the Foreign Nationals and Commonwealth Citizens (Employment) (Amendment) Regulations, as Grenada's Parliament publishes it. Fees are in Eastern Caribbean dollars. Permanent residence is applied for on forms witnessed by a Justice of the Peace or notary with references, police certificates (of Grenada among others), a letter giving the date of arrival in Grenada and the activities engaged in there, and a medical report done at the General Hospital laboratory, remitted to the Office of the Prime Minister with a fee of EC$275 plus a EC$5.10 transaction fee (EC$275 written; the sheet also says those in Great Britain and Canada pay the equivalent of EC$255.10, which doesn't agree, and isn't written). A foreign national's employment needs a work permit under the Foreign Nationals and Commonwealth Citizens (Employment) Act, Cap. 115, whose fee by the 2015 Regulations is $1,000 for citizens of The Bahamas, Barbados, Belize, Jamaica, Montserrat, Suriname, Trinidad and Tobago and Cuba, and for entertainers of those states and Guyana $2,500 a band or $500 an individual, citizens of the OECS states named paying none; the principal Regulations' fee for everyone else wasn't read, so no fee is written. No term, renewal, decision time, years to permanent residence or temporary residence route was found; the Immigration Department's own pages weren't found. The lead took out the permanent residence fee on 2026-10-30: the instruction sheet gives both EC$275 and EC$255.10, so the fee is left out.

sources.title: High Commission for Grenada, London: Instruction Sheet for Permanent Residence
sources.said: INSTRUCTION SHEET FOR PERMANENT RESIDENCE ... Letter stating date of arrival in Grenada, purpose of visit, the activities engaged in and reason why applicant would like to acquire Permanent Residence Status. ... Fee EC$275.00 plus EC$5.10 transaction fee to be made payable to “Government of Grenada” ... Persons residing in Great Britain and Canada should make money order or Cashier’s Cheque equivalent to EC$255.10. ... Office of the Prime Minister

sources.title: Grenada, S.R.O. 26 of 2015, Foreign Nationals and Commonwealth Citizens (Employment) (Amendment) Regulations
sources.said: Jamaica, Montserrat, Suriname, Trinidad and Tobago, and Cuba shall pay a work permit fee of one thousand dollars. ... two thousand five hundred dollars, in respect of a band; ... five hundred dollars, in respect of an individual entertainer.
